# Merve Sahiner — Interior Architect and Designer

> The official portfolio of Merve Sahiner, an interior architect and designer based in Turkey and working internationally. Her practice focuses on luxury residential interiors, space planning, FF&E, material and finish selection, technical documentation, architectural visualization, and sustainable material research.

Merve Sahiner has professional experience with Luzione in the United States, Aksiyal Architecture in Turkey, Kurtsan Group in Cyprus, and Maisons CBI in France. She holds a Bachelor of Interior Architecture from Eastern Mediterranean University and is pursuing an M.Sc. in Architecture at KTO Karatay University.

## Portfolio

- [Official portfolio](https://mervesahiner.github.io/portfolio/): Biography, selected interior architecture projects, professional experience, services, skills, education, awards, and contact information.

## Selected Projects

- Göcek Luxury Villa, Fethiye, Turkey — full-scope residential interior design, 2026.
- Twin Villa Design, Konya, Turkey — luxury residential concept development and visualization, 2024.
- Penthouse Design, Famagusta, Cyprus — space planning, material selection, and visualization, 2023.
- Office Design, Famagusta, Cyprus — commercial interior planning, documentation, BIM coordination, and visualization, 2024.
- Selected Kitchen Designs — kitchen planning, cabinetry detailing, material studies, and visualization, 2023–2026.
